goal: Expose and govern the full useful LPC ecosystem for Havenwild without coupling third-party art licenses to Havenwild code or hiding unbound source content from authoring workflows.
sourceAuthorities: Universal LPC Spritesheet Character Generator pinned repository
OpenGameArt exact source pages discovered through LPC collections
rules: Code/editor/runtime remain separately licensed from third-party artwork.
Editing a third-party image inside Havenwild does not erase that image's source license.
Original Havenwild-authored art created without derivative copying remains project-authored.
Raw third-party source repositories remain immutable authoring dependencies.
Editor may browse catalogued content before runtime binding; missing gameplay metadata is shown as a readiness warning rather than hiding the source.
Release fails closed for blocked or unverified asset provenance.
Runtime packages contain only used/promoted/generated assets plus required attribution, not complete source repositories.

domainPasses.W81R19: universal asset browser v2 authority and browser projection
